mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening consumer demand and labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines & UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declines and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4%) and a low GDP growth rate (GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY) signals a restrictive monetary policy coupled with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4% and GDPC1 growth is below 1% YoY.
